description: The 2026-10-21 Cloudflare spec dropped `destinationConf` from every Workers observability destination response configuration; earlier specs declared it as a required string. Keep it as an optional member, marked sensitive because it embeds header values, so a response that still carries it decodes it and a response without it still decodes. alchemy's Cloudflare.ObservabilityDestination exposes it as a Redacted attribute (alchemy-run/alchemy#2372).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The underlying Logpush destination string: the URL with the configured headers encoded as query parameters, so it can carry credentials. Optional: the 2026-10-21 spec omits it.
